verdict.rationale: Marqeta's JIT Funding docs describe exactly the core loop: your system receives a funding request in real time and approves or denies it using your own business rules, which is the auth-decisioning webhook the story describes, and separate webhook docs confirm real-time event delivery to a developer-hosted endpoint. However, none of the evidence documents the network's response time budget or a configurable/documented timeout fallback behavior (e.g., default decline-on-timeout) that the developer can control. Missing for 10: documented time budget/SLA for responses, explicit timeout fallback behavior and configuration options, independent confirmation of latency handling in production.
